mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(REFUND_PRODUCT_FEN), 0) AS refundProductFen, COALESCE(SUM(REFUND_SERVICE_FEN), 0) AS refundServiceFen, COALESCE(SUM(REFUND_PRODUCT_ML), 0) AS refundProductMl FROM ws_after_sale_action WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND ACTION_STATUS = #{successStatus} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: a.ID AS id, a.AFTER_SALE_NO AS afterSaleNo, a.SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, a.SOURCE_ID AS sourceId, a.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, o.ORDER_TYPE AS orderType, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, o.PAY_WAY AS payWay, p.PAY_SOURCE AS paySource, o.ORDER_AMOUNT AS orderAmount, a.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NAME AS userName, u.USER_PHONE AS userPhoneRaw, a.CARD_ID AS cardId, c.CARD_NO AS cardNo, a.ACTION_TYPE AS actionType, a.STRATEGY_CODE AS strategyCode, a.APPROVED_COUNT AS approvedCount, a.REFUND_PRODUCT_FEN AS refundProductFen, a.REFUND_SERVICE_FEN AS refundServiceFen, a.REFUND_PRODUCT_ML AS refundProductMl, a.REFUND_AMOUNT AS refundAmount, a.ACTION_STATUS AS actionStatus, a.VERSION AS version, a.RETRY_COUNT AS retryCount, a.NEXT_RETRY_TIME AS nextRetryTime, a.APPROVE_BY AS approveBy, e.EMPLOYEE_NAME AS approveByName, a.APPROVE_TIME AS approveTime, a.FINISH_TIME AS finishTime, a.LAST_ERROR AS lastError, a.CREATE_TIME AS createTime

FROM ws_after_sale_action a LEFT JOIN ws_order o ON o.ID = a.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ws_payment p ON p.ORDER_ID = o.ID LEFT JOIN ws_user u ON u.ID = a.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ws_card c ON c.ID = a.CARD_ID LEFT JOIN api_employee e ON e.ID = a.APPROVE_BY
mapper.update: UPDATE ws_after_sale_action SET RESULT_ORDER_ID = #{resultOrderId}, RESULT_TASK_ID = #{resultTaskId}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATE_BY = #{opUserId}, UPDATE_TIME = #{now} WHERE ID = #{id} AND DATA_STATUS = 0 AND VERSION = #{expectedVersion} AND ACTION_TYPE = 4 AND ACTION_STATUS = 1 AND RESULT_ORDER_ID IS NULL AND RESULT_TASK_ID IS NULL

UPDATE ws_after_sale_action SET ACTION_STATUS = 3, FINISH_TIME = #{now}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, LAST_ERROR = NULL, UPDATE_BY = #{opUserId}, UPDATE_TIME = #{now} WHERE ID = #{id} AND DATA_STATUS = 0 AND ACTION_TYPE = 4 AND ACTION_STATUS IN (1, 2) AND RESULT_TASK_ID = #{resultTaskId}
